A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Sentience/Legends|being]], '''Oshi-Jid''' attained the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="OTF" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] broke out between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and Oshi-Jid took the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Teo Gronn]] as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] after Gronn's [[Lyron|former master]] had been [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|first battle of the war]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="OTF" />

A few weeks into the war,<ref name="Date" /> Oshi-Jid was part of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic forces]]<ref name="OTF" /> sent to [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|capture]] the planet [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]], home of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]].<ref name="TNEC" /> Oshi-Jid was presumed to be killed [[Space warfare/Legends|in combat]] [[Realspace/Legends|over]] Muunilinst, leaving Gronn once again without a master.<ref name="OTF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Oshi-Jid was mentioned in ''[[Only the Force]]'', a stand-alone adventure written by [[J.D. Wiker]] and released by the [[Wikipedia:RPGA|RPGA]] on behalf of [[Wizards of the Coast]] in [[2004]].<ref name="OTF" />
